title: Applications of Flux Compactifications in F-Theory
summary: This thesis studies 4D F-theory compactifications with fluxes and their connection to particle physics, accompanied with a review of F-theory. First, we develop a general formalism for gauge symmetry breaking with fluxes. Vertical and remainder fluxes can be used to break a rigid gauge group, with the former simultaneously inducing chiral matter, even when the unbroken gauge group has no complex representations.
